verses.sanskrit:
लोमश उवाच।
              तानुवाच समेतांस्तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। गच्छध्वं विबुधाः सर्वे यथाकामं यथेप्सितम्॥१॥
verses.english: Lomasha said: The Grandsire of creatures Brahma thus spoke to the assembly (of celestials) “O gods, go wherever you like and desire to go.

verses.sanskrit: महता कालयोगेन प्रकृतिं यास्यतेऽर्णवः। ज्ञातींश्च कारणं कृत्वा महाराज्ञो भगीरथात्॥२॥
verses.english: A very long time must pass before the ocean would be able to resume its natural state by making the relatives of the great king Bhagiratha as its cause."

verses.sanskrit: पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे विबुधसत्तमाः। कालयोगं प्रतीक्षन्तो जग्मुश्चापि यथागतम्॥३॥
verses.english: Having heard the words of the Grandsire, all those foremost of celestials went away where they liked and they waited for the time (when the ocean would be refilled).

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              कथं वै ज्ञातयो ब्रह्मन्कारणं चात्र किं मुने। कथं समुद्रः पूर्णश्च भगीरथप्रतिश्रयात्॥४॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said : O Brahmana, O Rishi, why and how did the relations (of Bhagiratha) become the cause (of refilling the ocean)? How was the ocean refilled by the interference of Bhagiratha?

verses.sanskrit: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण तपोधन। कथ्यमानं त्वया विप्र राज्ञां चरितमुत्तमम्॥५॥
verses.english: O ascetic, O Brahmana, I desire to hear all this in detail, the excellent history of that king (Bhagiratha) narrated by you.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रेन्द्रो धर्मराज्ञा महात्मना। कथयामास माहात्म्यं सगरस्य महात्मनः॥६॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by the highsouled Dharmaraja, Yudhishthira, that foremost of Brahmanas narrated the glory of the illustrious Sagara.

verses.sanskrit:
लोमश उवाच।
              इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातः सगरो नाम पार्थिवः। रूपसत्त्वबलोपेतः स चापुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥७॥
verses.english: Lomasha said: In the race of the Ikshvaku there was born a king, named Sagara, possessing beauty of person and prowess. That mighty king was son-less.

verses.sanskrit: स हैहयान्समुत्साद्य तालजङ्घांश्च भारत। वशे च कृत्वा राजन्यान्स्वराज्यमन्वशासत॥८॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, exterminating the Haihayas and Talrangas and subjugating many kings, he ruled over his own kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्ये त्वभवतां रूपयौवनदर्पिते। वैदर्भी भरतश्रेष्ठ शैब्या च भरतर्षभ॥९॥
verses.english: O best of the Bharata race, he had two wives, proud of their beauty and of their youth, one a princess of Vaidarbhi and the other a princess of Shaibya.

verses.sanskrit: स पुत्रकामो नृपतिस्तप्यते स्म महत्तपः। पत्नीभ्यां सह राजेन्द्र कैलासं गिरिमाश्रितः॥१०॥
verses.english: O king of kings, desiring to get a son, that king practised great austerities with his two wives on the Kailasa mountain.

verses.sanskrit: स तप्यमानः सुमहत्तपो योगसमन्वितः। आससाद महात्मानं त्र्यक्षं त्रिपुरमर्दनम्॥११॥
verses.english: Being engaged in great austerities and in Yoga and in contemplation, he saw the illustrious three-eyed deity, the chastiser of Tripura, Shankara, Bhava, Ishana, Pinaki, Shulapani, Traymbaka, Shiva, Ugresha of many forms, the husband of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्करं भवमीशानं पिनाकिं शूलपाणिनम्। त्र्यम्बकं शिवमुग्रेशं बहुरूपमुमापतिम्॥१२॥
स तं दृष्ट्वै वरदं पत्नीभ्यां सहितो नृपः। प्रणिपत्य महाबाहुः पुत्रार्थे समयाचत॥१३॥
verses.english: As soon as he saw that giver of boons, that mighty-armed king bowed to him along with his two wives and prayed for a son. Hara (Shiva) being pleased said to that best of kings with his wives. “O king, considering the moment in which you have asked the boon.

verses.sanskrit: तं प्रीतिमान्हरः प्राह सभार्यं नृपसत्तमम्। यस्मिन्वृतो मुहूर्तेऽहं त्वयेह नृपते वरम्॥१४॥
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि शूराः परमदर्पिताः। एकस्यां संभविष्यन्ति पत्न्यां नरवरोत्तम॥१५॥
verses.english: O foremost of men, sixty thousand heroic and proud sons will be born in one of your two wives. O ruler of men, they will all together meet with destruction. In the other wife will be born a heroic son who will perpetuate your race."

verses.sanskrit: ते चैव सर्वे सहिताः क्षयं यास्यन्ति पार्थिव। एको वंशधरः शूर एकस्यां संभविष्यति॥१६॥
एवमुक्त्वा तु तं रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। स चापि सगरो राजा जगाम स्वं निवेशनम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Having said this, Rudra (Shiva) then and there disappeared. The king Sagara also went back to his own abode.

verses.sanskrit: पत्नीभ्यां सहितस्तत्र सोऽतिहृष्टमनास्तदा। तस्य ते मनुजश्रेष्ठ भार्ये कमललोचने॥१८॥
verses.english: Accompanied by his two wives who were exceedingly glad at heart. O foremost of men, he returned' home. His two lotus-eyed wives, the princesses of Vaidarbhi and of Shaibya conceived. In due time, the Vidarbha princess gave birth to a gourd.

verses.sanskrit: वैदर्भी चैव शैब्या च गर्भिण्यौ संबभूवतुः। ततः कालेन वैदर्भी गर्मालाबुं व्यजायत॥१९॥
शैब्या च सुषुवे पुत्रं कुमारं देवरूपिणम्। तदालाबुं समुत्स्रष्टुं मनश्चक्रे स पार्थिवः॥२०॥
verses.english: The princess of Shaibya gave birth to a son as handsome as a celestials. That king then thought of throwing away the gourd.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्तरिक्षाच्छुश्राव वाचं गम्भीरनिःस्वनाम्। राजन्मा साहसं कार्षीः पुत्रान्न त्यक्तुमर्हसि॥२१॥
verses.english: But he heard a voice in the sky uttered in a grave and solcinn voice; it said "O king, do not be guilty of this hasty acts. You should not abandon your sons.

verses.sanskrit: अलाबुमध्यान्निष्कृष्य बीजं यत्नेन गोप्यताम्। सोपस्वेदेषु पात्रेषु घृतपूर्णेषु भागशः॥२२॥
verses.english: Take out the seeds from the gourd and let inem be preserved with care in họt vessels partly filled with Ghee.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुत्रसहस्त्राणि षष्टिं प्राप्स्यसि भारत। महादेवेन दिष्टं ते पुत्रजन्म नराधिप। अनेन क्रमयोगेन मा ते बुद्धिरतोऽन्यथा॥२३॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, you will then get sixty thousand sons in this manner. Let not your mind be diverted.
